name: Plenoxel Sigma Threshold Ray Tracing
definition: A CUDA kernel function that finds the first sample along a ray where density exceeds a given threshold, returning the normalized distance to that sample.
summary: Plenoxel Sigma Threshold Ray Tracing is a CUDA kernel that finds the first sample where volume density exceeds a threshold, differing from standard rendering by using a hard cutoff instead of integrating transmittance.
